summary: Highway Holdings, a British Virgin Islands/Hong Kong manufacturer, filed a 6-K disclosing a Nov. 4, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with David Lazar for 1,750,000 Series AA and 1,750,000 Series AAA Preferred Shares at $2.00 each, $7,000,000 aggregate cash. Series AA converts into 924,872 common shares (~19.99% pre-investment); on shareholder approval both series represent ~95% of fully diluted shares, effecting a change of control. Directors and officers holding ~24.9% agreed to vote in favor; a special meeting is targeted within 90 days. The deal pairs with a planned spin-off of the legacy manufacturing business. Watch shareholder approval and conversion mechanics as the arb pivot.
